summary: Join our expert-led training course on surface water quality management. Learn essential techniques to monitor and protect vital water resources effectively.
lede: Surface water quality management uses planned sampling and reliable data to understand water conditions and guide action. It is for environmental and compliance staff, water utility teams, catchment managers, WASH practitioners, industrial EHS teams, consultants, technicians and researchers who need to assess water quality and recommend responses. The course covers monitoring plan design, field sampling and QA/QC, interpreting results and trends, identifying pollution sources, and communicating findings through clear reports.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for a wide range of professionals who are responsible for protecting water resources and ensuring compliance.
audience: Water utility and treatment plant personnel
NGO WASH and environmental program leads
Public sector staff in environment, water, health
modules: Foundations of Surface Water Quality Management
Field Sampling Techniques and Field Safety
Core Water Quality Parameters That Drive Decisions
Quality Assurance and Quality Control for Credible Data
Data Interpretation, Trend Analysis, and Exceedances
Pollution Source Identification and Catchment Thinking
Managing Incidents and Water Quality Emergencies
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental science principles. Familiarity with water monitoring techniques will be beneficial but is not required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
